description: Give OpenVibe.Actor a task: POST /api/v1/tasks with the task in plain words, a mode (cheapest, balanced, best, fastest, private) and a budget. Actor picks the agent system for it with openvibe-sdk/placement, runs it, has a second model family check the result, and records the result, the cost to the cent and the explanation on the task (platform.task@1, answered 201 with state queued). POST /api/v1/tasks/:id/cancel stops a task that has not ended. A person's tasks are theirs; a token that names a project puts the task in that project. Each person has a daily free allowance; a task whose cheapest eligible agent would cost more than its budget fails with actor.budget.exceeded instead of running.
